affected_version: Exact published 0.5.2 tarball contains the same raw default pack/report writes. Failing-before execution used the prepatch candidate; earlier versions unassessed.
invariant: Generated pack and inherited report destinations stay within the repository. Explicit operator exports carry separate per-output authority. Known linked/special targets fail before any output; regular-file replacement must not widen private POSIX permissions or truncate hardlink peers.
strategy: One command-local output list preflights all targets and rechecks every sink. Default outputs use existing contained atomic replacement; explicit exports use existing external atomic writer with optional mode preservation. Explicit primary authority is inherited only by its own sidecars; independent explicit report flags do not authorize default primary output.
before: 11 of 15 tests failed: default ancestor/leaf/report links, mixed report authority, explicit leaf dereference, hardlink peer modification and FIFO blocking. Four ordinary/dry-run controls passed.

after.result: 42 passed; zero failures/skips. Covers generated and explicit destinations, inherited reports, independent explicit reports, native export names, dry-run, all known-target preflight, unchanged Git staging, FIFO refusal, hardlinks and private modes.

Parent reproduced both default/explicit failures, passed existing rwx mode into each temporary writer, and reran focused, installed and full checks. No second review cycle; final exact-range task-828 review remains required.
